title: Entity and Mention Enrichment Fields
description: Entity and aggregate-mention fields embedded in main content-item documents. Occurrence lists describe accepted mentions in the article body; title mentions are not included in this contract.

pers_mention_offsets_json_plain.description: JSON-encoded ordered array of [start, length] pairs for accepted person mentions in the article body.

pers_mention_surfaces_json_plain.description: JSON-encoded ordered array of exact person mention surfaces corresponding positionally to the offsets (former pers_mentions).

pers_mention_qids_json_plain.description: JSON-encoded ordered array of linked entity QIDs or null for each corresponding person mention.

pers_aggregate_mention_ids_ss.description: Aggregate mention IDs for person surface/type groups present in this content item, including groups containing NIL occurrences.

pers_mention_ner_conf_dpfs.description: Existing payload serialization of person mention surfaces and NER confidence values on the 0-1 scale.

pers_entity_ids_dpfs.description: Entity QIDs with counts of linked person occurrences in this content item; NIL occurrences contribute no entry.
